root_cause.text: In aie2_send_mgmt_msg_wait(), when a timeout (-ETIME) occurs, ndev->mgmt_chann is set to NULL, but aie2_hw_stop() later calls xdna_mailbox_stop_channel() and xdna_mailbox_destroy_channel() on that NULL pointer without any NULL check, leading to a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces a helper aie2_destroy_mgmt_chann() that checks for NULL before operating on mgmt_chann, and replaces the direct destruction code in aie2_hw_stop() and aie2_hw_start() with calls to this helper. The CVE description explicitly states that mgmt_chann may be set to NULL by an unexpected error in aie2_send_mgmt_msg_wait(), causing a NULL pointer dereference in aie2_hw_stop().
